title: Budgeting as a Couple: 3 Systems Compared (Real Numbers)

lines.say: There are three main systems. Let's run real numbers through all three, and see what fair actually looks like.

lines.cap: Our example couple: Alex takes home $4,000 a month. Sam takes home $2,500.
lines.say: Our example couple. Alex takes home four thousand a month. Sam takes home twenty-five hundred.

scene.label: Shared bills, per month
scene.sub: rent, utilities, groceries, insurance, the car

lines.cap: Their shared bills come to $3,250 a month.
lines.say: Their shared bills come to thirty-two fifty a month.

lines.cap: Each pays $1,625. Alex has $2,375 left. Sam has $875.
lines.say: Each pays sixteen twenty-five. Alex has twenty-three seventy-five left. Sam has eight seventy-five.

scene.text: 50/50 takes 65% of Sam's pay, and 41% of Alex's.

lines.cap: It sounds fair. But it takes 65% of Sam's pay, and only 41% of Alex's.
lines.say: It sounds fair. But it takes sixty-five percent of Sam's pay, and only forty-one percent of Alex's.

scene.sub: Both pay half their pay · left over

lines.cap: Alex earns about 62% of the total, so Alex pays about 62% of the bills: $2,000. Sam pays $1,250. Now both pay exactly half their income.
lines.say: Alex earns about sixty-two percent of the total, so Alex pays about sixty-two percent of the bills. Two thousand. Sam pays twelve fifty. Now both pay exactly half their income.

lines.cap: Both paychecks go in: $6,500. Minus the bills, $3,250. Minus $300 of fun money for Alex. Minus $300 for Sam.
lines.say: Both paychecks go in. Sixty-five hundred. Minus the bills, thirty-two fifty. Minus three hundred of fun money for Alex. Minus three hundred for Sam.

lines.cap: $2,650 a month goes to shared goals.
lines.say: Twenty-six fifty a month goes to shared goals.

scene.head: WHICH SYSTEM FITS?
items: By income: different pay, separate accounts
Every system: no-questions money for each

lines.say: Fifty-fifty works when incomes are similar, or the relationship is newer. Split by income when pay is different. One pot fits couples with fully shared goals. And in every system, each person gets some money with no questions asked.

scene.text: Fair isn't equal dollars. It's a deal you both agree on.

lines.say: Fair doesn't have to mean equal dollars. It means a deal you both agree is fair. And talk numbers once a month, together.
